notes.title: March 2023 Update
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Just wanted to let everyone know about the progress. I'm about 50% done with writing Saori's route which is the last route I need to finish before moving on to the NSFW part of the game. I'm planning on releasing the game without the NSFW first and then have a patch come later down the line with it. 

We are a bit behind on art assets and because of that, once I'm done with writing, I'll be also drawing up some pieces for the game to help in that front as well.

Here is a quick breakdown of where I'm at with writing:

Common route: DONE
Yukari's route: DONE
Shiori's route: DONE
Emily's route: DONE (still need a bit of work but close)
Saori's route:
Written: 50%
QC: 20%
Implemented: 20%


Anyway, that's all from me, thanks again for all of your patience!

Eric
